* '''Playtest''' ([[Always Two There Are (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-alwaystwothereare-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/alwaystwothereare.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: “If you just lost a Dark Jedi and have exactly one Dark Jedi on table, ▲ a Dark Jedi. OR Once per game, if you have exactly two Dark Jedi on table, choose: Opponent loses 2 Force OR make a just drawn destiny = 2.”
* '''Original''' ([[Always Two There Are]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-alwaystwothereare-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/alwaystwothereare.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: “If you just lost a Dark Jedi and have exactly one Dark Jedi on table, ▲ a Dark Jedi. OR Once per game, if you have exactly two Dark Jedi on table, choose: Opponent loses 2 Force OR make a just drawn destiny = 2.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics; same words.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-D-alwaystwothereare.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/alwaystwothereare.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: “If you just lost a Dark Jedi and have exactly one Dark Jedi on table, ▲ a Dark Jedi. OR Once per game, if you have exactly two Dark Jedi on table, choose: Opponent loses 2 Force. OR Make a just drawn destiny = 2.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: “Opponent loses 2 Force OR make a just drawn destiny = 2.” became “Opponent loses 2 Force. OR Make a just drawn destiny = 2.” (full stop added, “make” capitalised); re-rendered at high resolution. '''PC transcription error:''' the words changed but the card prints no errata mark (this is errata version 1 by release order, PC-E1); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
